heading: Students
sub: What to expect as a PTI trainee — from your first day to graduation.
seo_title: Students — Pioneer Technical Institute, Iganga Uganda
seo_description: Life as a Pioneer Technical Institute trainee — support, expectations, and what to expect through your training in Iganga, Uganda.
seo_keywords: PTI students, Pioneer Technical Institute trainee life, vocational student Uganda

sections.heading: Who Trains at PTI
sections.body: PTI welcomes trainees from all academic backgrounds — from P7 leavers joining a Junior Certificate trade course, to UCE (S4) graduates joining a National Certificate programme, to working adults picking up a short course to add a new skill. Learners with disabilities and special needs are also welcomed.

sections.heading: Support While You Train
sections.body: Department heads and instructors are available for academic and welfare support throughout your course. Trainees are also expected to follow the Institute's Student's Charter, which sets out both your rights and your responsibilities as a member of the PTI community.

sections.heading: What's Next
sections.body: See the Student's Charter for the full rights-and-responsibilities policy, and Life at PTI for what day-to-day training looks like.
